Date: 2026-10-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Ariba invite accepted but status still 'Pending — verification required'

Hi Irene,

We accepted the Ariba invitation that your team sent yesterday for the ProcurePlus vendor account, but the supplier portal still shows our account status as "Pending — verification required". Acceptance flow completed on our side (I attached a screenshot), and the acceptance email shows as delivered. We don't see any error on Ariba's side.

We have a PO approval window tomorrow and need access to upload invoice/PO docs. Can you check why acceptance didn't transition the account to "Active"?

Screenshot attached: screenshot-pending.png
Ariba support ticket (their ref): #A-12947

Thanks,
Susan Wu
Procurement Manager
ProcurePlus

ProcurePlus Onboarding Team

Hi Susan — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. Sorry for the disruption, we'll take this on.

Quick notes / next steps:
- Ben (platform ops) and Monica (CS) are looped in; Ben will check the SAML / assertion logs and whether our onboarding webhook received the acceptance callback from Ariba.
- If we can't auto-resolve, we'll do a manual verification to move the account to Active; we'll need a short piece of info for identity verification (see Ben's note below).

Ben / Monica: can you confirm whether the Ariba acceptance event reached our ingestion endpoint? I pushed this to SUP-9821 and linked the external ticket.

I'll follow up with Susan when we have a clear next step.

Thanks,
Irene
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Wu <susan.wu@procureplus.com>
Date: 2026-10-24T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba invite accepted but status still 'Pending — verification required'

Thanks for the tag, Irene. I pulled the Ariba assertion and our webhook logs. High-level findings:

1) We received an assertion event from Ariba at 2026-10-24T09:11:58-07:00 but the SAML NameID in the assertion is "susan.wu+vendor@procureplus.com" while our onboarding service stores and matches the canonical email without plus-tags.
2) Ariba reports the acceptance for that assertion ID, but our onboarding matching logic does an exact string match on email to move a supplier from "Pending" to "Active". Because the assertion email included a plus-tag, the lookup failed and the account remained Pending.
3) Additionally I see the Ariba assertion included an attribute displayName: "ProcurePlus (US)" and our tenant alias mapping for ProcurePlus is "procureplus-corp" — that's fine. The root cause is the exact-email mismatch.

Immediate remediation options:
- We can run a one-off reconciliation to match the plus-tagged address to the existing ProcurePlus vendor record and flip status to Active (fastest).
- Longer-term: update the onboarding matcher to normalize plus-addressing and lower-case comparison for email fields. I'll open an RFC/PR after the hotfix.

For the manual reconciliation I need the simplest identity confirmation we can use from ProcurePlus to avoid creating a security hole. Susan: could you reply with the last 4 digits of your company's vendor tax ID (or upload the vendor-id-verification-form.pdf filled) and confirm the Ariba username that accepted the invite? If you prefer, we can accept a pull from your Ariba admin console showing the acceptance event ID.

Attachment: ariba-saml-assertion.txt (extracted assertion for debugging)

Plan: I'll queue the reconciliation once we get the verification and will update SUP-9821 with exact actions. Monica, can you help with communications and to fast-track the manual flip if verification checks out?

Ben
Platform Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference

Susan
